desc.zh:
温明园中上，董卓悍然提出废立之议，丁原率吕布怒而反对。董卓觊觎吕布骁勇，施计诱其叛丁原投己...

触发条件：董卓、吕布、丁原、李儒、卢植、王允、李肃存活

亲历条件：【身属董卓势力，完成十常侍之乱剧情】

禁忌条件：主角不为丁原
desc.en:
At Wenming Garden, Dong Zhuo brazenly proposed deposing the Emperor, provoking furious opposition from Ding Yuan and Lu Bu. Coveting Lu Bu's valor, Dong Zhuo devised a scheme to lure him into betraying Ding Yuan and defecting to his side...



Trigger Condition: Dong Zhuo, Lu Bu, Ding Yuan, Li Ru, Lu Zhi, Wang Yun, and Li Su are alive



Participation Condition: 【Belong to Dong Zhuo's Faction, complete the Chaos of the Ten Attendants plot】



Ineligible Condition: Protagonist cannot be Ding Yuan

progress.en: Head to Luoyang to attend the banquet

if.zh: 玩家势力 = 董卓 或 董卓：NPC势力已签订信义契约 = 是
if.en: Player's faction = Dong Zhuo or Dong Zhuo: the player belongs to their faction = yes
Dong Zhuo is not the player
Lu Bu is not the player
Ding Yuan is not the player

story.zh: 温明园中上，董卓悍然提出废立之议，丁原率吕布怒而反对。董卓觊觎吕布骁勇，施计诱其叛丁原投己...
story.en: In Wenming Garden, Dong Zhuo brazenly proposed deposing the emperor, meeting furious opposition from Ding Yuan and Lu Bu. Coveting Lu Bu's prowess, Dong Zhuo plotted to lure him into betraying Ding Yuan and joining his ranks...

trigger.zh: 吕布、李儒、王允存活且身处正确的势力；董卓、丁原为君主
trigger.en: Lu Bu, Li Ru, and Wang Yun are alive and belong to the correct Factions, Dong Zhuo and Ding Yuan are Rulers

forbidden.zh: 主角为丁原时无法触发
forbidden.en: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Ding Yuan

participate.en: 【Belong to Dong Zhuo's Faction, and complete the Chaos of the Ten Attendants plot】

defy.zh: 【<主角身为吕布>留在丁原势力下】
defy.en: 【<Protagonist is Lu Bu> Remain under Ding Yuan's Faction】

force.zh: 董卓身为君主并占领<洛阳>
force.en: Dong Zhuo is Ruler and occupies <Luoyang>

force.zh: 丁原身为君主并占领<晋阳>
force.en: Ding Yuan is a Ruler and occupies <Jinyang>

force.zh: 李儒、王允回归董卓势力
force.en: Li Ru and Wang Yun return to Dong Zhuo's Faction.
Lu Bu returns to Ding Yuan's Faction.
